topology: regular candidate grid, Moore 8-neighbour adjacency at radius=1 cell
thresholding: none; continuity uses local mean or robust local similarity rather than a field-tuned membership threshold

normalization.local_similarity: candidate-frame median/IQR standardization of predeclared terrain features followed by exp(-mean neighbour Euclidean distance)
normalization.local_mean: arithmetic mean over self plus existing Moore neighbours
normalization.rank: deterministic within-frame percentile rank with no tuned cut point

WETLAND_MOISTURE_STRUCTURE.terrain_continuity_score_raw: local mean of min(inverse-rank tpi300, inverse-rank slope100)

ALPINE_TOPOGRAPHIC_STRUCTURE.landform_continuity_score_raw: local similarity of elev, slope100, tpi300, rough300
ALPINE_TOPOGRAPHIC_STRUCTURE.ridge_valley_continuity_score_raw: local mean of two-sided TPI rank extremeness

OPEN_GRASSLAND_STRUCTURE.terrain_context_score_raw: local similarity of slope100, tpi300, rough300

COASTAL_ISLAND_STRUCTURE.island_component_score_raw: 1 only for the predeclared target ecological_component_id; 0 otherwise
COASTAL_ISLAND_STRUCTURE.fail_closed: target_component_id and ecological_component_id are both required

FOREST_EDGE_STRUCTURE.terrain_component_score_raw: local similarity of slope100, tpi300, rough300

coastline_source.source_of_record: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan Fundamental Geospatial Data, Basic Items, coastline
coastline_source.snapshot_rule: Use a downloaded private snapshot frozen before patch generation and record source release date plus SHA-256 in the private candidate-frame manifest.
coastline_source.authentication: GSI download requires user registration/login; do not replace it silently with an older easy-to-download coastline product.

boundary: G_E produces ecological continuity primitives only. G_F access/permission is applied later and cannot create ecological support.
next_gate: Build the private 13-unit candidate frames with pinned GSI DEM, ESA WorldCover, GSI coastline where needed, then run the HMAC patch freeze before field outcomes.
